en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘If an Occultation reaches you all regarding the Master<sup>asws</sup> of this command, so do not be denying it’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from from his father from ibn abu “Umayr from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following.
“I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, “I the person in charge of this task (Leadership with Divine Authority) will disappear from public sight you must not reject it.”
